blocking_deficit: Accepted owner-VPS G4/headless FDX evidence stops before an independently observed audio graph. The new repository helper reaches a software/Pulse null-sink candidate surface, but its current OLD_SENTINEL is offered only after the generation fence has already advanced and is therefore rejected before sink admission. That path can prove stale-generation gating but cannot by itself falsify buffered old audio already admitted before cancel.

why: old_pre/PRE is written before cancel but is not the old-generation sentinel whose post-cancel persistence is later asserted
OLD_SENTINEL is represented by old_queued and is offered only after fence.cancel(), so GenerationFence rejects it before the sink
OLD_SENTINEL absence from monitor readback therefore cannot distinguish correct playback cancellation from a sink that continues already-buffered pre-cancel audio
the corrected current G2 benchmark requires control playback/readback plus a cancellation run that measures the last monitor sample still attributable to the already-admitted old packet

control_run: Use one deterministic long old-output waveform containing an identity-rich old-generation marker pattern throughout the portion that can be in flight, not only in a post-fence chunk.
Bind it to the exact old VoiceOutputPacket and output_generation.
Start PipeWire monitor capture before playback; play the entire waveform; preserve raw source and monitor hashes.
Align normalized monitor PCM to the source so graph latency/sample-rate transformation and marker detectability are measured before cancellation is interpreted.
cancel_run: Replay the identical waveform through the identical virtual graph and output lineage class.
Issue existing causal barge/cancel only after monitor/control evidence proves playback has begun and while source material remains eligible to be buffered/in flight.
Keep monitor capture active for a post-cancel window longer than the measured graph quantum/latency.
Record cancel request, packet terminal transition, playback-client stop/deactivate/flush-or-equivalent transition and monitor sample timeline in one monotonic clock domain where possible.
Compute the last monitor sample/window still attributable to the old waveform and cancel-to-last-old-sample tail_ms.
new_generation_run: After the old packet is terminal, play a distinct new-generation waveform through the same sink/monitor.
Prove clean new-generation identity and no re-admission/resurrection of the terminal old packet.
